title: AWS Transfer to Amazon S3
description: Create AWS Glue tables from Athena and integrate with S3.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern in CDK offers an example to setup an AWS SFTP server using AWS Transfer for SFTP. You can simply create a server, set up user accounts, and associate the server with one or more Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) buckets.

You have fine-grained control over user identity, permissions, and keys. You can create users within Transfer for SFTP. You can also use IAM policies to control the level of access granted to each user.
